doc.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024

chapter: Playing, recording and making a living
title: Capturing live spirit in the studio and recording Maqueque
summary: Studio feel depends on rehearsal time; the last record had days after Covid, while earlier ones followed visa waits and touring.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: When you get in the studio with your group, do you have a technique to create the kind of spirit that happens live?

That’s a great question. Try to. I think we try to but that’s — you know I guess it really depends on the conditions around the recording and how much we’ve rehearsed you know because we’ve been up against — when we did our last record we only had a couple of days, we brought the musicians in and this was just shortly after things opened

up after Covid. We only had a couple of days to do our recording so a lot of stuff was worked out in the studio, as opposed to other recordings where everybody has lived in our house and we, and that situation was always kind of different because we’d be waiting for the visas. The girls would go for their interviews at the U.S. Embassy here in Toronto. We would have to wait a couple of weeks before the approval and being able to pick up the visas. In that time we would be rehearsing every day, so — from morning ‘til, you know, end of day. And really, really workshopping the music and playing and experimenting and then, you know the visa thing would happen and then we’d go out on the road and do a tour, come back and do the recording. And so then it was so easy to be able to just — because we were so seasoned with the music and it was so under our belt and everything, to make it feel like it was live in front of an audience because we just was coming off the road and feeling really fresh and had tried so many, you know, every angle to shape the music and create something new. So generally the ideal thing is to do it like that I think. Yeah.
